import React, { useState } from "react";

const stops = [
  { name: "Compose", zone: "renderer", title: "Intent, not privilege.", text: "The chat asks a typed Promise-based Client to send a prompt. Ordinary Stores do not construct RPC envelopes or import Pi.", evidence: "src/renderer/client/ClientLive.ts", lines: "273–279", fact: "sessionChats.prompt delegates to the generated RPC client." },
  { name: "Cross", zone: "bridge", title: "A narrow crossing.", text: "Preload exposes a frozen send / subscribe transport. Shared schemas parse values at receiving boundaries; preload is not a second business layer.", evidence: "src/preload/preload.ts", lines: "5–19", fact: "Only cake.rpc is exposed; ipcRenderer remains private." },
  { name: "Dispatch", zone: "main", title: "Cake chooses the operation.", text: "Main binds the caller’s renderer connection and delivers the prompt through Cake’s conversation domain. Filesystem and native authority stay here.", evidence: "src/ipc/server/SessionChatHandlers.ts", lines: "6–20", fact: "sessionChats.prompt routes through bindRenderer and deliver." },
  { name: "Run", zone: "pi", title: "Pi runs the agent.", text: "The Pi Session Runtime owns the agent loop, tools and transcript. It is embedded in main—not a separate server, and not a sandboxed extension host.", evidence: "src/services/pi/PiSessions.ts", lines: "596–598", fact: "The Pi service handle delegates prompt to its adapter." },
  { name: "Project", zone: "renderer", title: "A view, not another transcript.", text: "Validated snapshots and ordered events return to window-owned observers. Reactive Models project the result; Pi remains the transcript authority.", evidence: "docs/architecture/cake-architecture.md", lines: "135–150", fact: "Observers apply validated updates; raw Pi shapes stop at the Pi service boundary." },
];

export default function Explanation() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [sources, setSources] = useState(false);
  const current = stops[step];
  const active = (zone) => current.zone === zone ? " active" : "";

    </header>

"Hide evidence" : "Inspect evidence"}</button><button className="next" onClick={() => setStep((step+1)%stops.length)}>{step === 4 ? "Start again" : "Next: " + stops[step+1].name}</button></div>
